doping of Co and Ni in place of Fe leads to the reduction in magnetization, while doping with Ga leads to the suppression of magnetism in YBaCuFe1−xMxO5 (x = 0.15; M = Co and Ni).
, the magnetic and the non-magnetic doping of the magnetic site of YBaCuOFe5 results in shifting of magnetic transition temperature to the lower temperature.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the partial replacement with non-magnetic and magnetic ions at the magnetic site in layered perovksite multiferroics results in the shifting of the magnetic and the dielectric transitions towards lower temperature side.
the partial replacement at the magnetic site of Fe with non magnetic Ga results in shifting of magnetic ordering and dielectrics anomaly to lower temperature.
the magnetic dilution and the broadening of magnetic transition in the system can be controlled by the partial replacement of Fe with other metal ions.
